Name:  ___                  Unit No:   ___

Chief Complaint:
High Amikacin trough & unable to use IV abx at home (long 
infusion times, frequent infusions)
 
Major Surgical or Invasive Procedure:
none

 
History of Present Illness:
___ male s/p liver transplant ___ for ETOH cirrhosis with 
complicated postop course s/p drainage of a large subcapsular 
perihepatic collection
noted on ___ that grew Linezolid sensitive enterococcus. 
Discharged to rehab,then readmitted ___ with sepsis and CT 
findings suggestive of small bowel pneumatosis. He underwent 
exploratory laparotomy, lysis of adhesions with temporary 
abdominal closure with a ___ patch on ___. On ___ he 
had exploratory laparotomy; closure of abdomen with component 
separation and debridement of skin, subcutaneous tissue, and 
muscle; abdominal wound closure. He required tracheostomy and 
bronchoscopy on ___ for failure to wean from the vent and 
was treated with amikacin for pseudomonas pneumonia. He also 
experienced urinary retention requiring a foley and 
re-institution of flomax. He was discharged to ___ on 
___ and seen by Dr. ___ on ___ who noted large post void 
residual. Discharged to home with service on ___. The ___ 
feels he cannot manage an IV pump to do IV antibiotics at 
home.He also Amikcin trough 9.0 . Given his multidrug resistant 
pseudomonal bacteremia Now readmitted for IV antibiotics.
 
Past Medical History:
Alcoholic cirrhosis, s/p Liver transplant ___ 
exploration for  hematoma and fluid collection; prior ascites; 
prior hepatorenal syndrome requiring several sessions of 
hemodialysis; known grade II esophageal varices and portal 
gastropathy by EGD ___ history of candidal and bacterial 
(SBP) peritonitis; colorectal cancer (stage unknown) s/p 
colectomy in ___ cervical stenosis; hyperlipidemia; HTN; h/o 
CDiff; anemia with baseline Hct ___ h/o history of Torsades 
while on ciprofloxacin; depression; h/o positive PF4 antibody;  
BPH; ___ Exploratory laparotomy, Lysis of adhesions, 
temporary abdominal closure with a ___ patch; ___  
Exploratory laparotomy; closure of abdomen with component 
separation and debridement of skin, subcutaneous tissue, and 
muscle; abdominal wound closure; ___ Tracheostomy and 
bronchoscopy

___

The patient was admitted to ___ surgery on ___. His 
meropenem was continued and amikacin was held to check for 
troughs. Amikacin was administered on ___. A trough level was

___ consulted and supervised ambulation.

Follow up cultures are to be obtained following the completion

Medications on Admission:
Fludrocortisone 0.1', Tamsulosin 0.4', Bactrim SS', Epoetin Alfa
